data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season, and our village depends on us doing that. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month: that leaves 50, which doubles back to 100. If we stick to that, each of us can earn $10,000 every month without draining the lake. I propose a 10-ton limit each, with everyone reviewing the reported catches afterward. John, would you agree?
